reviews.text: My little dog was saved by these animal health professionals and I thank them immensely.
Excellent veterinary clinic, immediate care despite appointments. I'm choosing this vet for my dog.

My 3-month-old kitten was scratching his ear until it bled. The initial diagnosis was "it's not mange." After numerous unsuccessful treatments, I was advised to see a behaviorist (which I didn't do). When I changed vets, I was told it had been mange all along. So I paid for four consultations, only to end up making my kitten's condition worse; he had to wear an Elizabethan collar for six months...
The staff are very kind and welcoming. Dr. Chorel is gentle and attentive; I highly recommend her.

Disappointed. Before, the gentleman was good, but now it's a complete mess. Money comes first, not the animal. So we let my sick cat come home and she died. They should have given her something to ease her pain; they gave me a can of pâté. In short, zero.
Very welcoming in a city office... competence to be confirmed as this was the first visit...

Hello,
Thank you so much for your positive review of our veterinary clinic.
Providing a calming environment and high-quality care for your pet is our priority.
Thank you again for your trust.
Your veterinary team
A very good and caring veterinarian. Clear explanations.

Thank you, Dr. Chorel 🙏🏻.

I was very stressed about Chocapic's (aka Peach) spaying today, but it went very well. I picked her up in the afternoon, and she's already in great shape as soon as I got home: she's playing, eating, and cuddling. And the scar is very small.

A huge thank you! 🙏🏻 This practice also treats my two other cats (Shaki and Cookie), and things are going very well with them too!
I arrived at 6:52 PM (closing time 7 PM) after work to pick up my cat's food, and the shop was closed! There was no holiday notice on the storefront... I don't understand?
The reception and consultation went perfectly. Thank you to the doctor for his patience and kindness.

Thank you to Dr. Chorel and his assistant for taking such good care of my dog ​​after he was attacked. My dog's treatment was quick and carried out with care and kindness. My dog ​​has recovered from his injuries and is doing very well 😊 …

Hello,
We have received your message and are sincerely sorry to hear of your dissatisfaction.
The health and well-being of your animals are our top priority, and we strive to provide each and every one of them with quality service.
We invite you to contact us by phone, email, or even directly at the clinic so that we can discuss the problems you have encountered.

Sincerely,
The Veterinary Team,

We are very disappointed with the new management of this practice. Our cat was being treated there with a clear protocol agreed upon with the previous vet: no surgery, only care to ensure she didn't suffer.

The new vet refused to renew a treatment she had already received and tolerated well, which was noted in her file, claiming he absolutely had to see her. (🤑)
However, our cat needs to be sedated for every trip (also noted in her file), which is too risky and traumatic.
We asked to be called back to find a solution: no response.
This attitude demonstrates a complete lack of consideration for the well-being of the animal and its owners.
The veterinary assistant and veterinarian are attentive and very competent; you can tell they love our animals. I trust them.

Hello,
Thank you for your positive feedback and for your trust.
Knowing that our efforts to provide your pet with the best possible care are appreciated motivates us every day.
Our team remains at your disposal to provide quality care and answer any questions you may have.

Your veterinary team

Hello,
Your trust and positive feedback towards our team mean a great deal to us.

We are delighted that our care was beneficial for your pet.

We remain available to provide you with convenient service and answer any questions you may have.

Your veterinary team

Be aware that this story will never end. Our cat died following the sterilization performed by Dr. d'Auriac.
Our cat is dead, and of course, everyone has their own excuse. No one knows what our cat died of! Because the culprit is Dr. d'Auriac, you will carry the death of our cat on your conscience for the rest of your life. This practice is to be avoided if you want to keep your animals alive.
Furthermore, he has the nerve to ask us for hospitalization fees for a mistake he made! SHAMEFUL!
The doctor was incredibly gentle and affectionate with my very scared kitten after inhaling a lot of smoke. I was also very reassured! Thank you so much!

A huge thank you to Annick and Dr. Dupas, who were incredibly helpful, professional, attentive, and above all, incredibly kind to Zina, my little protégé, whom I welcomed with her four puppies four days ago. I recommend your practice without hesitation. Thank you again, and see you very soon with Junior, who loves his vet! 🤗🤗🥹😋 …
